title: Editor Table Authoring Gate
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository set, Checklist target, or Evidence target before editing.
Table, table-row, table-cell, and table text descendant selections cannot be distinguished by explicit Editor facts.
Selected table descendants expose ready Text or Columns add actions that imply table-cell authoring is available.
Unsupported table row or column authoring lacks an exact blocked reason.
Table preview text descendants cannot be traced back to table, row, and cell ids for future authoring QA.
The slice adds Core or Backend table mutation transport before those repositories advertise table operations.

The slice enables WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, direct table/cell editing, exact table layout authoring, durable drafts, collaboration, production readiness, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
verificationTarget: Editor exposes bounded table authoring gate facts so table/row/cell/text selections are distinguishable, unsupported table structure intents are blocked with a single exact reason, selected table descendants do not expose misleading ready add actions, and Paper/Inspector surfaces expose table context without enabling mutation transport or WYSIWYG behavior.
summary: Done: Editor merge commit 87def6310b1ff061d999c6f4b336976e1a3852f0 adds a bounded table authoring gate. tableAuthoringBoundary resolves table, table-row, table-cell, and table text descendants such as detail-cell-a-text into tableId/tableRowId/tableCellId/textBlockId facts with selection levels table, row, cell, and cell-text. Unsupported insert-row, delete-row, insert-column, and delete-column intents remain blocked with the exact reason Table authoring is gated until Backend/Core advertise table mutation operations. addNodeVisibleActions now blocks selected table descendants with the same reason instead of presenting ready Text/Columns add actions after the represented Table surface. InspectorPanel shows the table authoring boundary only for table contexts, and Paper/render projection expose data-canvas-table-id/data-canvas-table-row-id/data-canvas-table-cell-id for represented table text descendants. This does not enable Core or Backend table mutation transport, document v4 insert semantics, direct table/cell editing, exact table layout authoring, WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, durable drafts, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
